hits.snippet: By: David Love, Quiver Editor Quiver Quantitative Logo Etsy (ETSY), the popular e-commerce platform known for its unique and handcrafted goods, witnessed a significant drop in its share value following the announcement of an 11% workforce reduction. The company plans to lay off 225 employees, bringing its total staff down to 1,770, as part of its cost-cutting efforts in response to a downturn in demand. This move will incur financial charges between $25 million and $30 million, primarily for severance and related benefits. Etsy's decision comes amid broader organizational changes, including the departure of key executives such as Chief Marketing Officer Ryan Scott.
